headings.leadersBlurb: These four are the automatic AFC seeds. Everyone else is chasing the three wild cards.
headings.pathsBlurb: Win the AFC South, or be one of the three best remaining clubs in the conference. The closer route is the one that matters.
headings.footer: Updated from ESPN’s public NFL feeds. Not affiliated with the NFL, the Indianapolis Colts, or ESPN.
headings.footerTiny: Seven AFC teams qualify: four division winners and three wild cards. The playoff percentage is a season simulation from point differential and home field. It is not a betting line.
headings.conclusion: The Indianapolis Colts have been mathematically eliminated from the NFL playoffs.
headings.injuryBlurb: Colts listed as injured or on injured reserve. A Tuesday practice note can move before Sunday.
headings.rootingBlurb: Who needs to lose for the division or the cut line to get closer. Not a betting line, and not a live in-game number.

ticker: 3.5 GB OF JAX IN THE SOUTH

narrative.headline: Three games off the cut line
narrative.blurb: The Colts are 2-6 with a -61 point differential, three games behind the last AFC playoff spot, and 3.5 games back of the Jaguars in the South. 9 games left, starting Sunday at home against the Cowboys.

division.detail: The Jaguars lead at 5-2. The Colts are 1-2 inside the division. Win the South and the seed is automatic.

wildcard.title: Wild card
wildcard.detail: The Patriots hold the last berth at 5-3. Three wild cards get in after the four division winners.

tiebreak.headToHead: Head-to-head inside the South: W 19–17 vs HOU; L 20–26 vs TEN; L 7–42 @ JAX.
tiebreak.detail: If the South finishes level, the NFL starts with head-to-head, then division record, then common games, then conference record. Point differential is the eye test. It is not the first tiebreaker.
